title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy describes what data WishList App collects and how we use it.
dataItems: Your name and email from your Google account - only when signing in via Google
The contents of your wishlists and added items
Usage statistics for public pages through Google Analytics
useText: We use data to run the service, identify your account and store lists. Personal wishlists are unlisted in search, but anyone with a link can view and reserve gifts. Do not include sensitive information. We do not sell your personal data.
storageText: Firebase (Google Cloud) stores account and wishlist data. Google Analytics processes usage data for public pages; personal wishlist URLs and user-entered content are excluded from analytics events.
rightsText: You can delete your account and all associated data at any time - email us at rost.redko@gmail.com. Wishlists you have shared become inaccessible after deletion.
contactText: For privacy enquiries, email us at
